scenes.description: Clip 01: 戰後日本戰敗與1945歷史開場
scenes.narration: 首先，讓我來講個故事…二次大戰之後，日本戰敗。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Static wide overhead shot looking down at archival paper desk, slow 8% punch-in sustained from 00:03.0 to 00:05.4.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Off-white aged newsprint background with faint grid lines, halftone black-and-white cutouts with clean drop-shadowed edges, physical paper tactile feel.
LIGHTING: Flat even studio tabletop illumination, warm 3400K, soft ambient paper shadows.
LOCATION: Archival historical document workspace from 1945.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.8: Frame starts empty on aged paper. A bold distressed paper label stamped "A TRUE STORY: 1945" slams into top center with a crisp drop shadow.
- 00:01.8-00:03.6: A halftone cutout silhouette of post-war destroyed Tokyo city ruins slides in rapidly from the right and locks into position; paper smoke puffs animate upward in stop-motion.
- 00:03.6-00:05.4: An archival vintage paper map of Japan drops flat onto the desk; a jagged red rubber stamp slams down across the map reading "DEFEAT".
TEXT: "1945", "DEFEAT"
AUDIO: Paper slap impact at 00:00.8, paper slide flutter at 00:02.0, heavy dull rubber-stamp thud at 00:04.0, subtle low ambient documentary drone, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, glossy 3D render, motion blur, full-sentence subtitles, spoken dialogue.

scenes.description: Clip 02: 麥克阿瑟將軍與五星司令部SCAP
scenes.narration: 為了協助日本重建，盟軍主帥麥克阿瑟將軍，

required_assets.description:

STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion animation, 12 FPS, zero motion blur. Aged off-white newsprint, halftone photo cutouts, prominent drop shadows, hand-drawn vector elements.
LIGHTING: Directional top-down warm key light, soft physical drop shadows beneath layered paper edges.
LOCATION: Post-war Tokyo reconstruction war room desk with faded map sheets.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.2: The war ruins slide left. A prominent vintage halftone cutout silhouette of a 1940s five-star Allied Supreme Commander officer (wearing an officer peaked service cap, aviator sunglasses, and vintage corncob pipe) slides up from the bottom edge with a layered drop shadow.
- 00:02.2-00:04.4: Five golden craft-paper cut stars pop into existence above the commander's shoulder one by one in snappy stop-motion timing; a bold paper cutout tag "SCAP" snaps in below.
TEXT: "COMMANDER", "SCAP"
AUDIO: Fast paper slide whoosh at 00:00.5, snappy mechanical clicks for star placements, chalk circle scribble swoosh, low rhythmic pulse, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, 3D render, motion blur, character lip sync, full-sentence subtitles.

scenes.description: Clip 03: 太平洋越洋航線與美國專家顧問團
scenes.narration: 就從美國組了一群顧問團來幫忙。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Overhead flat-lay view of a Pacific Ocean map chart, fast whip-pan from left (USA) to right (Japan).
STYLE: Vox paper collage explainer, 12 FPS, no motion blur, tactile paper cutouts, vintage aeronautical chart styling.
LIGHTING: Neutral studio lighting, 4000K, minimal specular reflection on paper.
LOCATION: Vintage Pacific aeronautical paper navigation map.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.8: A vintage parchment chart of the Pacific Ocean unfurls. An animated black dotted flight line draws itself from Washington D.C. across the ocean toward Tokyo.
- 00:01.8-00:03.5: Three halftone cutouts of American technical advisors in 1940s fedoras and trench coats holding leather briefcases slide into frame; a red paper pointer snaps down labeled "ADVISORS".
TEXT: "USA -> JAPAN", "ADVISORS"
AUDIO: Map unrolling flutter at 00:00.5, rapid telegraph ticker clicks at 00:01.2, crisp briefcase latch snap, ticking clockwork percussion, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: smooth digital CGI, modern planes, digital flight paths, motion blur, spoken dialogue.

scenes.description: Clip 04: 統計學大師登場、黑板常態分佈與普查文卷
scenes.narration: 這顧問團裡面有一位戴明博士，原本是個統計學家，是要來幫日本進行人口普查的，

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Medium shot on graph paper desk, snapping rightward to census documents at 00:04.5.
STYLE: Vox paper collage stop-motion, 12 FPS, archival research aesthetic, blackboard textures, halftone photography.
LIGHTING: Warm 3200K top-left key spotlight casting defined paper drop shadows to the right.
LOCATION: 1946 statistical analysis bureau desk with census ledgers.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.5: The advisors slide out. A sharp, dignified halftone portrait cutout of a 1940s American statistical scholar and professor (round spectacles, bow tie, tweed suit) slides in and locks at center-left.
- 00:02.5-00:04.8: A dark chalkboard cutout slams behind the professor, instantly displaying hand-drawn chalk normal distribution bell curves and variance formulas; a yellow highlighter block sweeps over "STATISTICS".
- 00:04.8-00:07.3: A vintage 1946 Japanese census document drops onto the desk; tiny paper silhouette figures stamp onto data rows in rapid succession while a brass magnifying glass cutout slides over data columns.
TEXT: "PROFESSOR", "CENSUS 1946"
AUDIO: Chalk writing squeak on board at 00:02.8, marker highlighter squeak at 00:04.0, rapid mechanical tally clicker sounds, intellectual light strings with clockwork rhythm, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: mouth movements on portrait, animated blinking, warped face features, full-sentence subtitles, CGI.

scenes.description: Clip 05: 戰後日本產業殘破與DEFECTIVE紅印章
scenes.narration: 但看到日本產業殘破不堪，品質低劣，

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Fast crash-zoom into center frame at 00:00.8, holding locked-off as elements crash down.
STYLE: Vox-style stop-motion collage, 12 FPS, harsh contrast, torn cardboard edges, distressed dark textures, jarring physical movements.
LIGHTING: High-contrast harsh sidelight, cold 4500K mixed with dim ambient gloom.
LOCATION: Post-war ruined industrial workshop floor.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.8: The census sheet violently rips down the middle and drops away. A dark, jagged-torn red craft paper backdrop crashes in.
- 00:01.8-00:04.0: Halftone cutouts of broken factory cogs, cracked vacuum tubes, and bent bicycle frames tumble down; a heavy red rubber stamp violently drops: "DEFECTIVE".
TEXT: "CRACKED", "DEFECTIVE"
AUDIO: Harsh paper tearing rip at 00:00.6, metallic clattering and paper impact sounds at 00:02.0, heavy violent stamp slam at 00:03.2, dissonant low industrial bass, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: polished 3D metal, smooth CGI smoke, full-sentence subtitles, spoken voice.

scenes.description: Clip 06: 開班傳授品質管理、PDCA四象限旋轉與提昇
scenes.narration: 所以，他也開始傳授日本企業品質管理技巧，希望能幫忙提昇他们的產品品質，

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Locked-off medium shot, transitioning smoothly to a wide graph board framing at 00:04.5.
STYLE: Vox paper collage motion design, 12 FPS, educational infographic aesthetic, chalkboard texture, crisp vector chalk lines.
LIGHTING: Bright, clean studio lighting, 3500K, optimistic contrast.
LOCATION: Clean lecture chalkboard on aged graph-paper backdrop.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.4: The red scrap paper sweeps off screen to the right. The statistical professor cutout slides back in from the left; a clean dark-green chalkboard cutout snaps down at center.
- 00:02.4-00:04.8: A hand-drawn circular 4-stage arrow diagram (PDCA: Plan-Do-Check-Act) animates onto the chalkboard in crisp white chalk lines with rotating arrowheads.
- 00:04.8-00:07.1: A bright green paper upward trendline tears across the blackboard, accompanied by miniature factory silhouettes stamping into alignment.
TEXT: "PDCA", "QUALITY UP"
AUDIO: Paper sweep whoosh at 00:00.8, crisp chalk drawing screech and click at 00:02.8, upward paper tearing sound at 00:05.2, upbeat rhythmic pulse with progressive momentum, no dialogue.
NEGATIVE: 3D animated gears, computer graphics UI, full subtitles, spoken speech.

scenes.description: Clip 07: 擴大市場與促進就業

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Wide shot on an economic atlas, continuous snappy pull-back revealing global export network.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage, 12 FPS, vibrant infographic styling, vintage world map texture, bold physical trendlines.
LIGHTING: Vibrant warm studio lighting, 3600K, crisp multi-layered paper drop shadows.
LOCATION: Global trade parchment map surface.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.6: The chalkboard flips into a vintage world map; bright red cutout shipping route arrows shoot outward from Japan to major world ports labeled "EXPORT".
- 00:01.6-00:03.2: Halftone paper cutouts of bustling factory workers slide across the lower third; a bright yellow starburst badge pops onto the corner stamped: "JOBS".
TEXT: "EXPORT", "JOBS"
AUDIO: Map unrolling whoosh at 00:00.5, distant factory whistle at 00:01.5, heavy rubber stamp thud at 00:02.5.
NEGATIVE: modern cargo container ships, 3D globe animation, subtitles.

scenes.description: Clip 08: 貝爾實驗室、管制圖與事實統計
scenes.narration: 那戴明的這套品質管理技術，其實起源自美國，強調要觀察事實，還有統計分析。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Top-down medium shot on cyan blueprints, sliding horizontally across data tables.
STYLE: Vox paper collage explainer, 12 FPS, technical blueprint aesthetic, archival patent documents, typewriter typography.
LIGHTING: Cool 4000K fluorescent drafting lamp light with defined paper edge shadows.
LOCATION: 1930s engineering drafting board with cyan blueprint grids.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.4: An authentic 1930s Bell Telephone Laboratories patent document cutout drops onto the cyan blueprint table with an American flag paper ribbon across the top.
- 00:02.4-00:04.8: A statistical process control chart cutout with Upper and Lower Control Limits (UCL / LCL) snaps onto the center; a brass magnifying glass slides over data rows.
- 00:04.8-00:07.2: A rough yellow highlighter block draws over "FACTS"; beside it, a 4-bar paper histogram self-assembles bar-by-bar in snappy 12 FPS clicks.
TEXT: "BELL LABS", "FACTS ONLY"
AUDIO: Blueprint unrolling rustle at 00:00.8, typewriter bell at 00:02.5, marker highlighter squeak and 4 rapid click-pops at 00:05.2.
NEGATIVE: modern lab computers, high-tech glow, subtitles.

scenes.description: Clip 09: 美國忽視與TOO SLOW紅色印章
scenes.narration: 但這套技術因為緩慢費時，在美國並不受重視。

required_assets.description:
SHOT: Static medium shot, fast crash zoom-in to an hourglass at 00:02.5.
STYLE: Vox-style paper collage stop-motion, 12 FPS, satirical editorial cartoon tone, halftone corporate figures, dull drab color palette.
LIGHTING: Moody overhead office lamp, 3000K, cast shadows elongating across the desk.
LOCATION: 1950s American executive boardroom desk covered in untouched manuals.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.4: A vintage hourglass paper cutout drops onto the desk; sand trickles down inside in stepped stop-motion. A halftone cutout of an impatient American corporate executive checks his pocket watch.
- 00:02.4-00:04.9: The statistical report on the desk is shoved aside by a heavy rubber stamp slamming down with red ink: "TOO SLOW"; the report slides into a paper wastebasket with a grey paper dust puff.
TEXT: "TIME COST", "TOO SLOW"
AUDIO: Heavy hourglass thud at 00:00.8, pocket watch ticking, aggressive rubber stamp thud at 00:02.8, paper bin clatter at 00:04.2.
NEGATIVE: smooth 3D hourglass fluid, talking mouths, subtitles.

scenes.description: Clip 10: 日本注重細節與改善KAIZEN
scenes.narration: 沒想到，日本正好是個注重細節的民族，

STYLE: Vox paper collage stop-motion, 12 FPS, elegant minimalist Japanese aesthetic, washi paper textures, geometric grid precision.

LOCATION: Traditional Japanese workshop surface with natural fibers and calligraphic grid rules.

scenes.description: Clip 11: 倒茶三十道工序分解圖
scenes.narration: 連倒一杯茶，都可以分解成幾十個動作。

required_assets.description:

STYLE: Vox-style anatomical breakdown animation, 12 FPS, stop-motion photo tiles, technical sequence arrows.
LIGHTING: High-clarity museum display lighting, 3800K, even illumination across all tiles.
LOCATION: Minimalist tea ceremony staging paper mat.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:01.8: An antique Japanese ceramic tea bowl cutout sits at center; a paper teapot tilts, freezing a single cutout water droplet mid-air.
- 00:01.8-00:04.1: The scene bursts outward into 6 numbered stop-motion photo tiles arranged in a grid showing micro-movements, connected by hand-drawn black vector arrows and numbering sequence "01... 30".
TEXT: "TEA POUR", "30 STEPS"
AUDIO: Water droplet click at 00:00.8, 6 rapid camera shutter click sounds as tiles pop out, chalk line drawing whoosh at 00:03.8.

required_assets.description:

STYLE: Vox paper collage stop-motion, 12 FPS, historical auditorium panorama transitioning to organizational workflow diagrams.
LIGHTING: Classroom projector beam atmosphere shifting to clean 3500K office desk illumination.
LOCATION: 1950 JUSE Tokyo lecture hall transitioning to corporate executive headquarters.

scenes.description: Clip 15: 天皇頒贈勳章與大師歷史榮耀
scenes.narration: 戴明因此受到全日本的敬重，連天皇都頒贈勳章給他。

required_assets.description:

STYLE: Vox commemorative documentary paper collage, 12 FPS, golden textured craft paper, ceremonial royal stamps, celebratory paper confetti.
LIGHTING: Warm golden hour ceremonial lighting, 3000K, gentle sparkling paper reflections.
LOCATION: Archival Imperial ceremonial parchment backdrop.
ACTION:
- 00:00.0-00:02.0: The organizational chart folds away. An honorable, smiling halftone portrait cutout of the distinguished elder statistical scholar slides into center with a deep drop shadow.
- 00:02.0-00:03.8: A gleaming hand-cut golden medal cutout (The Order of the Sacred Treasure, Second Class) drops onto his suit lapel with a realistic paper shadow.
- 00:03.8-00:05.1: An Emperor's imperial chrysanthemum crest seal stamps down in rich vermilion red ink at top right; gold and white paper confetti drifts gracefully down in stop-motion.
TEXT: "HONOR", "IMPERIAL MEDAL"
AUDIO: Gentle royal trumpet chime in distance at 00:00.8, golden medal clink at 00:02.8, heavy imperial wax seal thump at 00:04.2, soft paper confetti flutter.
NEGATIVE: caricatures of the Emperor, modern fireworks, subtitles.
